The `cloud_stat` call failed because the previous token only had `service-log-level` scope. The observation provides a workaround: use `api_post /api/tickets/TCK-531513/size-report` to get a `status_path`, then poll that path until the status is "done".

Plan:
1. Call `api_post` to `/api/tickets/TCK-531513/size-report`.
2. Call `api_get` on the returned `status_path` until status is "done".
3. Once done, get the size.
4. Submit report.
